Thank you all for raising these important considerations. Let me address each one before I finalize the panel and process.

Third, Sofia — thank you for confirming the standardized question set and individual written score sheet requirements. We'll incorporate both into the selection packet before evaluations proceed.

Fourth, Tariq — thank you for raising Mara's accessibility request through the proper channel. Per our accessibility practice, once a candidate's stated needs are raised through the employee representative, they must be implemented. Mara will receive the interview questions at least 48 hours in advance and will be permitted to submit written responses. This may result in a different interview format for Mara, but equal treatment means equivalent opportunity to demonstrate the criteria — not identical format.

Given that Rina is excluded due to the conflict of interest, and the panel must contain three people from Elliot, Rina, Sofia, and Tariq, the panel will be Elliot, Sofia, and Tariq.

Before I formally settle this, does anyone have any additional process or accessibility considerations to add to the record?
